'''Ryan Page''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 North Carolina State Championship]] on 28 April 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM flip]], according to Brian Speight's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2216">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-01-oxford-north-carolina-states-4-28-01d2216/ oxford-north-carolina-states-4-28-01], DeckTech (Brian "Buccaneers" Speight, 1 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-01-oxford-north-carolina-states-4-28-01d2216/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
